nodes.label: "The prompt asks for entities to offset"
"Modify Offset takes a parabola and a hyperbola, and offsets them"
"A selection window takes the spline, not the segments it is drawn with"
"A click selects the spline itself, not a segment it is drawn with"
"Committing a spline offset replaces it with its offset, undoably"
"A trigger that offsets nothing keeps the action, its step and the selection"
"Only sources that were offset leave the selection"
"The preview shows the committed geometry, or its box past MaxPreview"
"With current attributes, the preview has the pen the commit gives"
"A failed preview request leaves no stale preview"
"Without additive selection every offset, and every failed source, stays selected"
"Parallel Through previews the whole offset of a parabola"
"Parallel Through previews the whole offset of a hyperbola"
"Parallel Through takes a spline, not a line it is drawn with, and passes through the point"
"A spline shrunk away keeps its source, and the message says why"
"An ellipse shrunk past its minor axis says nothing is left"
"Copies that stop short keep the source, and the message says how many fit"
"A spline refused by the engine is reported with the reason"
"A reference point on a line, with a fixed distance, gives no side"
"A series stopped by a failure keeps its copies, and the message says why"
"A spline off the drawing plane is refused with the reason"
"The preview says why a series stops, next to the copies it draws"
"A reference point on the spline takes the offset's side from the second click"
"A reference point snapped onto a drawn segment takes the side from the second click"
"A reference point off the spline still decides the offset's side"
"A reference point on a spline through points takes the side from the second click"
"The prompt says a distance can be typed, fixed or not, at either click"
"A typed distance fixes it, and the next click offsets by it"
"A typed distance in the two-click flow overrides the second click's own"
"Selected segments of a polyline are offset as one chain, and the polyline is kept"
"A lone selected segment of a polyline is offset on its own"
"Selected segments across a closed polyline's seam are one chain"
"Every segment of a closed polyline selected gives its closed offset"
"A chain of selected segments keeps an arc segment an arc"
"A deleted segment between two selected ones ends the chain"
"An elliptic segment is offset on its own, along its curve"
"Offset segments leave the selection, and their polyline stays"
"A segment selected with its polyline fares as the polyline does"
"An offset polyline starts and ends where its segments do"
